slices.title: Ladder module, legacy mapping, cache key
slices.summary: Adds the canonical ladder module in inference-core (Level, Wire, support, resolve, legacy budget mapping, allowance), the InferRequest.reasoning_effort and ModelInfo.effort_levels fields, and effort in the response-cache key; inert, with no wire or proto change. N1 (binding) makes the DoD a rebuilt inference-core run at quick then deep showing two distinct keys and a miss.
slices.needs_external: P0 probe (0.5 d, inside S1) needs live provider access: an OpenAI or Azure gpt-5-family route and Foundry access for claude-opus-4-8

slices.title: OpenAI/Azure reasoning_effort
slices.summary: Sends reasoning_effort on OpenAI and Azure reasoning-model request bodies through the ladder, raises max_completion_tokens by the level allowance, and fills effort_levels in capabilities and list_models; the body stays byte-identical when the level is None.
slices.needs_external: OpenAI or Azure gpt-5-mini credentials for the live quick-vs-deep proof; owner sign-off on the allowance cost (Q3, DEC-36)

slices.title: Anthropic wire classes
slices.summary: Replaces the budget-only Anthropic thinking block with ladder wire classes (budget for budget-class models, adaptive with summarized display plus output_config effort, or none for standard). The default of INFERENCE_CORE_ANTHROPIC_ADAPTIVE_THINKING depends on the P0(iii) probe result.
slices.needs_external: Foundry access for the claude-opus-4-8 live proof (P0); owner sign-off on the allowance cost (Q3, DEC-36)

slices.title: Codex via ladder
slices.summary: Routes the Codex subscription request through the ladder with wire CodexEffort and levels Low and High only (Medium maps to Low, XHigh and Max to High), and keys the priority service tier on the resolved Low level instead of the legacy 1024 budget; standard stays low without priority.
slices.needs_external: A ChatGPT-subscription Codex connection (user sign-in) for the live proof; without it the slice must state 'not proven live'

slices.title: Proto level, catalogue field, single gateway derivation
slices.summary: Adds enum ReasoningEffort, InferRequest.reasoning_effort = 17 and ModelInfo.effort_levels = 8 to inference.proto, one gateway derivation (thinking.rs plan) shared by the normal, ZDR and source-validation paths, and effort_levels on /v1/models, behind MODEL_GATEWAY_EFFORT_LADDER (off = legacy budget). N2 (binding): additivity is proven by a tag-number diff against git show HEAD, not by buf breaking.
slices.needs_external: Live provider credentials for gpt-5-mini and claude-opus-4-8 and a Codex subscription connection for the three-route live proof; DEC-39 integrator assigns the final tag numbers

slices.title: Composer levels from catalogue
slices.summary: Exports EffortProfile and EffortLevel from chat-client.ts, sends effort on ChatInvokeRequest, parses effort_levels from /v1/models into ModelInfo and modelEffortLevels(model), and makes the composer response-mode select read it, adding Maksimal/Maximum only when the selected model lists xhigh; no action contract.
test_commands: cd "apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3" && pnpm vitest run src/shared/api/chat-client.test.ts src/features/chat/lib/pending-chat-launch.test.ts src/shared/api/ag-ui-client.test.ts

slices.title: Policy seams (gated on Q8)
slices.summary: Clamps effort to Low when intent forces a cheap fallback or the budget is exhausted (intent.rs choose and resolve, fallback.rs resolve_intent), adds clamp_to_cap(level, cap) with cap None until WS10 supplies one, and records the per-role cap as Control-owned in the capability ownership matrix. Optional, gated on Q8.
slices.needs_external: WS10 cap source (Control Plane) and the Q8 decision (DEC-13 and DEC-36); an exhausted-budget org fixture from cost-core

slices.title: Do/Plan-run effort (gated on Q1; keep 0 in W1)
slices.summary: Adds RunAgentRequest.reasoning_effort at final tag 21 (section 4.3, superseding the 19-or-later proposal), wires it through gateway run start, and replaces the literal 0 effort in execution-core run_rounds with the run level for chosen rounds, behind EXECUTION_CORE_RUN_EFFORT (default off). Optional, gated on Q1, kept at 0 in W1; a ledger entry supersedes the code comment.
slices.needs_external: Q1 owner decision (DEC-36); live provider credentials for a Do run with Deep and the per-round cost delta

slices.title: Codex broker medium/xhigh (gated on Q7, cross-plane)
slices.summary: Lets the Ingestion Plane Codex broker accept medium and xhigh reasoning effort (manager.go validation), with its mapping and rejection tests updated, and makes the Model Plane Codex ladder row Low, Medium, High, XHigh. Optional and cross-plane: the broker deploys first, and integration-corev2/.env tokens are never touched.
slices.needs_external: Ingestion Plane integration-corev2 owner for the broker deploy and the Q7 decision (DEC-36); per-model Codex ladders are not yet determined
